_meta.note: UnityEngine.UI.Text is m_Script fileID 708705254 in the UnityEngine.UI assembly (guid f5f67c52d1564df4a8936ccd202a3bd8). Strings are read from the raw bytes by tools/extract/ui-text.mjs, which folds multi-line YAML scalars properly; the shared unity_yaml.js parser returns only the first line of one.

briefing.note: panel_mission carries its own disableAfterDelay: disableDelay 3.8, enabled, targeting itself, at PlayerShip_SR14_Photon.prefab:10176 and :12320, mechanism in disableAfterDelay.cs:8-16. disableDelay is a public float with NO initialiser, so 3.8 is shipped behaviour and not a code default. A panel live at spawn (see liveAtSpawn above) is therefore killed 3.8 s after spawn; one that is not does not start its countdown until something activates it, because Start() does not run on an inactive GameObject. What activates it, if anything, is NOT traced here. HUD_Ship.DelayedStart (HUD_Ship.cs:88-99) then hides it a SECOND time at 0.12+4=4.12 s, against a panel already inactive for 0.32 s. 4.12 is real but it is NOT the figure: DEV-200 made that trade on the strength of a citation pointing at HUD_Ship.cs rather than at the prefab, and DEV-217 undid it. Ends in a newline, which is in the shipped bytes.

gatesLabel.ff2: src/render/hud.ts, the caller passes `countLabel`; app.ts sends 'GATES'
gatesLabel.note: 2016 writes `Gates:` in sentence case. The port upper-cases it.

speedLabel.note: The two HUDs disagree: first-person `Speed :`, third-person `SpeeD :`. Both carry a space before the colon, which the port drops.

timeEmpty.ff2: src/render/hud.ts, literal '--' for a mission with no timer

countPlaceholder.ff2: src/render/hud.ts `pad2`, the `00/50` shape is why counts are two-digit padded

outOfBounds.note: THREE lines, not one: `Warning!` / `Leaving event airspace` / `Turn back now!`. The countdown is a separate label parented to this one.

outOfBoundsCountdown.note: Authored as `12`, one less than the 13 s `PlayerBoundary.resetDelay` every scene ships.

courseComplete.ff2: src/render/results.ts, the port leads with the medal instead

medalLabel.ff2: src/render/results.ts, the medal is drawn with no label
medalLabel.note: TWO GameObjects under `panel_endUI` are both named `text_score`, so the only discriminator either has is FILE ORDER, and this is the first. That is a weak selector and it is deliberately used only here, on two labels FF2 does not draw: if Unity ever rewrote the prefab the pair would swap silently. Both strings are in `_meta.variants`, so the swap is at least visible in the output.

totalScore.ff2: src/render/results.ts, the score is drawn with no label
totalScore.note: The second `text_score` in file order. See `medalLabel`.

_meta.note: Trigger_EnableShip.DelayedEnable() waits `delay`, calls Timer_Race.StartCountdown() with no useCountdown check, and the countdown coroutine then sets useRaceTimer = true, so this is also when the race clock starts.

Matt, 2026-09-25: "gold medal = 90, plat = 100". bronze/silver/gold are the 2016 values; platinum is every ring. A missed ring forfeits the time bonus (DEV-393), so a run reaches platinum exactly when it takes every ring. DEV-004's time-based platinum is retired.
